data.gender_notes: Aadab is used for both boys and girls in South Asian Muslim naming.
data.long_meaning: Aadab (آداب) is the Arabic plural ādāb of adab, 'good manners, politeness, breeding, decorum'. It denotes the rules of courteous conduct and respect. In Urdu, ādāb is also used as a greeting of respect.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name points to courtesy and good conduct; any spiritual reading placed on it is interpretive and labelled as such.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadab total 9, reducing to 9. Number 9 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aadab mean?
faq.a: Aadab means Etiquette; good manners; decorum (ādāb).

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aadab?
What language does the name Aadab come from?
faq.a: Aadab is used in Arabic, Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aadab a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aadab is used as a unisex name.

faq.q: How is Aadab written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aadab is written آداب in Arabic and آداب in Urdu, and आदाब in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aadab?
faq.a: The root of Aadab is أ-د-ب (ʾ-d-b).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aadab?
Does Aadab appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; ādāb is Arabic vocabulary meaning 'manners, etiquette'.
Aadab is the Arabic plural ādāb of adab, meaning 'good manners, etiquette, decorum'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aadab?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadab total 9, reducing to 9. Number 9 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aadab?
faq.a: Aadab appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Adab, Adaab.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aadab?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aadab include Aadil, Aadam.

faq.q: Is Aadab a name or a greeting?
faq.a: It is both. Ādāb is a personal name meaning 'good manners', and in Urdu ādāb is also used as a greeting of respect.

faq.q: Where is the name Aadab used today?
faq.a: Aadab is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
